infra-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate (gateway timeout cluster) — SLO impact > 6m. Paging @sre_oncall and @eng-runtime. Correlation hint: trace prefix 0x7f3a

ashley.lee: seeing spikes in gateway 504s across region-us-west-2, alerts started ~16:02 UTC. customers reporting failures on /v1/generate. can someone pick this up?

sre_oncall: on it. I'm oncall until 17:00 — will triage. ETA 2m to confirm scope. Can we get sample correlation IDs?

matt: adding a few from logs: cor-id=7f3a1c9b, 7f3a2f10, 7f3a44a4. Logs show upstream response times > 10s then gateway gives up.

anita: 504s match gateway proxy timeout. There's an increase in upstream retries from edge -> runtime. looks like retry amplification.

eng-runtime: we see a backlog on model-pool-3, KV cache miss rate jumped. suspect long-tail inference on a small subset of requests (long contexts). rolling back a recent kernel tweak? last deploy 15:30.

ashley.lee: customer-impact: some heavy users will see request failures and increased latency. CS reporting a couple customers with timeouts. tagging @customer-success to notify priority accounts.

customer-success: acknowledged. we'll message the two affected accounts and provide ETA.

sre_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) increase gateway proxy timeout from 8s -> 20s (temporary) 2) enable route fallback to model-variant-b (quantized) for heavy routes 3) throttle aggressive retry headers at edge. Doing 1 now.

opsbot: running: kubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-config --patch '{"data":{"timeout":"20s"}}' -> success

sre_oncall: deployed timeout bump. monitoring.

matt: sharing minimal repro log chunk for timeline:```
[16:06:12] GET /v1/generate id=7f3a1c9b upstream=runtime-02 latency=11.2s attempts=3 status=504
[16:06:13] POST /v1/embeddings id=7f3a2f10 upstream=runtime-07 latency=12.1s attempts=4 status=504
[16:07:01] GET /v1/generate id=7f3a44a4 upstream=runtime-03 latency=9.8s attempts=2 status=504
```

anita: hypothesis list (quick):
- H1: recent runtime kernel change increased tail latency on certain sequences -> causes upstream to not respond within old timeout -> gateway 504s.
- H2: Retry amplification: clients/edge retry logic + gateway retries causing bursts to runtime, creating a positive feedback loop.
- H3: KV cache warming/regression for a subset of prompts -> increased inference cost/time.

eng-runtime: confirm there's a deploy at 15:30 that touched attention kernel selection heuristics. We can roll that back to confirm. preparing a canary rollback to model-pool-3 only.

sre_oncall: agree rollback to previous kernel on a single pool as canary first. Meanwhile keep timeout bump and fallback route. Need timeline: when did error rate start, which pools affected, and correlation IDs. matt/anita can you assemble logs by cor-ids into S3 bucket?

matt: collecting full traces for the cor-ids. uploading aggregated logs -> s3://redwood-incidents/1768459999/trace-bundle.tar.gz. sharing shortlinks and search queries.

opsbot: logs uploaded: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-incidents/1768459999/trace-bundle.tar.gz

sre_oncall: starting rollback on pool-3 canary now (kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-pool-3 --to-revision=42). will watch for traffic shape and error rate.

eng-runtime: canary rollback started. also enabling KV-prefetch on pool-3 to reduce cold misses.

anita: note: there's a cluster-level autoscaler event at 15:45 that might have reduced available GPUs briefly. investigating whether capacity dip correlates.

ashley.lee: timeline draft:
- 15:30 deploy (runtime kernel heuristic)
- 15:45 cluster autoscaler scaled down a node pool (short window of reduced capacity)
- 16:02 first alert spike -> gateway 504s increase
- 16:06 bulk 504s and alerting; mitigation actions start (timeout bump 16:08, fallback route 16:10, canary rollback 16:14)

matt: after timeout bump error rate decreased ~40% within 2m. still seeing intermittent 504s from long-tail requests. canary rollback succeeded, observing per-pool latency drop.

sre_oncall: current status: mitigation in progress, customer-impact degraded -> partial; we're keeping pager open. next steps: continue collecting traces, confirm rollback reduces tail latency across pools, evaluate need to revert kernel in all pools, and patch retry logic to avoid amplification.

eng-runtime: if rollback proves stable over 15m we can plan full revert. also will open an internal PR to add better per-request advisory headers to avoid retries.

customer-success: sending status update to customers now. thanks for the quick mitigation.

anita: adding follow-ups for RCA: share timeline, full trace bundles, kernel diff, autoscaler event logs, and the retry amplification analysis. tagging this thread for postmortem. :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: closing loop: continue monitoring for 30m; if error rate stays low we'll transition to post-incident RCA. adding notes to incident doc: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/1768459999 (draft). :eyes:
